info.title: TaskTracker Session Authentication
info.description: Session and CSRF only; not the PAT API. Legacy accounts keep their existing eligibility. New public registration requires an activation link; valid invitations verify the exact invited email during new-account registration. Activation GET only renders the page, with token in URL fragment. A verified account may have no active workspace; workspace and role are then null and permissions is empty. Workspace APIs still require active membership. Invitation login and registration never join implicitly; acceptance is a separate authenticated decision.

post.description: Public signup requires registration enabled and an activation link. A valid, unconsumed, not-declined invitation from a currently authorized inviter can prove the exact invited email for a new account. This creates only the account, returns workspace:null and empty permissions, and does not consume the invitation or create membership. The signed-in invitee must explicitly accept or decline. Existing accounts must log in.

post.summary: Invite an address by transactional email; no membership before acceptance
post.description: Session + CSRF, workspace.invite required before replay. Same requestId and exact payload replays the original result without another invitation/email. Different payload is 409. New request for the same email expires the previous link. Token-containing receipt is encrypted. 10/minute in local/production. Expires in 7 days. Legacy missing requestId remains one-shot. No automatic resend after uncertain delivery.

get.summary: Read this workspace pending, unexpired invitations only
get.description: Session-only, workspace.invite required. SQL pagination, stable expiresAt DESC and internal id DESC; no token, mail body, receipt or workspace snapshot. Accepted/expired invitations disappear. Member directory is separate. Declined invitations are excluded. Pending means not accepted, not declined and not expired.

post.summary: Request password recovery without revealing account existence
post.description: Session/CSRF boundary, no PAT. Fixed APP_URL, token in fragment. Recovery expires after 30 minutes; 60-second per-account resend cooldown; replacement invalidates previous links. No automatic login or email verification. Existing legacy sessions remain valid until that account resets its password.

post.summary: Create a workspace for the current eligible account without registering a second user
post.description: Session/CSRF only, 5 requests per minute. A current eligible member can create a workspace regardless of their role in other workspaces. The creator becomes owner and the session switches to the new workspace. User-scoped requestId replays the same creation; changed name conflicts. Replay requires active membership and never recreates a deleted workspace. Existing memberships are unchanged.

200.description: Current authenticated user, new workspace and effective owner permissions

403.description: Account not eligible or replay membership revoked

409.description: Request ID reused with a different name

post.description: CSRF required. Only valid high-entropy tokens are looked up. Current inviter permission is rechecked; unknown inviter, expiration or revoked permission fails. Preview discloses authMode only for an active invitation, never arbitrary email lookup. Acceptance/decline requires a current eligible account session and matching invited email. Accept is idempotent only while membership remains active. Decline is terminal for this token, closing the dialog is not decline. Registration/login do not accept. Invalidated legacy invitations with unknown sender must be reissued.

400.description: Invalid, expired, declined or revoked invitation

409.description: Already accepted invitation cannot be declined

post.summary: Disable or restore one workspace membership
post.description: Session+CSRF and current workspace.members.manage required. Target must be in the current workspace and its effective permission set must be manageable. Owner and self are protected. Preserve account, other memberships, project ACLs and history. A shared role_revision prevents lost status/role updates. Recheck actor/target before receipt replay; same request returns original result without repeating the event. Replaying an old disable after restoration does not disable again. A permanent event records actor, status, time and revision atomically. Existing PATs are denied while membership is disabled; restore does not restore revoked tokens.

200.description: id, revision, status and nullable disabledAt result

403.description: Insufficient current permission, Owner or self target

get.summary: Bounded workspace member directory by membership state
get.description: Session only, current workspace.members.read. SQL search and pagination with stable user name/user ID order; status defaults to active. Returns id/name/email/roleId/revision/canChange/disabledAt/canSetStatus. Inactive members cannot be role-edited, Owner/self cannot be status-changed.
